note: A beginner voice week at 17 minutes a day: a warm-up, an ear game and one longer musical piece that ends in a tune or line the student makes up. Every tune comes back in a second key through a Key selector, Do Mi Sol moves through three keys, one warm-up climbs a tempo ladder of stages and one opens with breathwork. Every note asked for is low in the voice, and where the singer could wander up the staff (the first staff, a slide, a skip up to Sol, a made-up line) one underlined care line says not to reach for high notes.

plan.title: Week 1: Do Mi Sol, in tune, your way
plan.summary: Sing in tune over a drone and skip through Do Mi Sol, one idea a day: each day a short warm-up, an ear game, and a longer musical piece that ends with a tune or line you make up.
plan.progress:
Pitch: finds the low Do over a drone in C, D and F and hears when it settles; slides and hums into Sol. Next: find Do without the hum first.
Breath & range: paced breath 3 to 6 counts, holds the low Do in G and D on "oo". All notes stayed in the low part of the range, with a line not to reach for high notes. Next: hold Sol, breath 3 to 7.
Intervals & leaps: tells steps, minor and major 3rds, 5ths and 6ths apart by ear, rising and falling, sings Do Mi Sol in A, C and D and Do Re Mi on the beat up to 92 bpm. Falling skips are less sure. Next: sing a 4th.
Melodies: easy step and skip tunes, each in two keys (C, D, G, A, F), one medium tune in A and D, own lines over two and three chords. Next: medium tunes in two keys.

days.theme: Do Mi Sol in new keys
